invariants.rationale: The method constructs and returns a new LinkedHashMap, so result cannot be null.
Each value in result is created from dedupedRecords, so all HoodieRecord<T> in the result map's values must exist in the input list.
Partitioning does not drop or duplicate records, so the total number of HoodieRecord<T> in the result map should equal the input list size.
If there are any partitions, partitioner must have been used to calculate keys, so partitioner is never null if partitions are present.
Each entry in result is created only for partition keys with at least one HoodieRecord<T>, so all value lists must be non-empty.
